tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed dang lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po mchod cing bskang ba'i cho ga brtan g.yo'i yid 'phrog dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs so// nā mo gu ru bhū ta ḍa ma ra sh+tsa ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye/ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs sku/ /log 'dren bdud kyi snying 'byin hūm̐ mdzad dang / /dbyer med bla ma mchog la gus btud nas/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin ma lus rgyas phyir dang / /'gro rnams 'phral yun rgud pa las skyabs phyir/ /khro rgyal 'byung po 'dul byed bka' nyan che/ /lha chen tshogs bdag mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ /'khrul bral dam pa'i gsung bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /de la 'dir gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang sdud kyi lha mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i bdag nyid srid gsum dregs byed kyi mthu bo dpal tshogs kyi bdag po 'di la mdo rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung gi zin so shin tu che bas rjes gnang sgrub thabs las tshogs bstod pa sogs kyi yi ge mkho che gras rnams phyogs gcig du bsgrigs pa'i be'u bum bzhugs pas/ der ma 'thus pa logs su 'dri rgyu med mod/ 'on kyang 'dir mchod gtor bskang ba'i rnam gzhag zhan pas las dang po pa rnams kyis rtogs sla ba'i phyir bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab las btus te gsal bar 'dri na/ de yang sngon du gnod sbyin bse gdong can la cho ga bzhin mnan pa byas la/ de yang chos brgyud gcig pa'i nus ldan gcig gis mnan pa byas pas slob brgyud lnga'i bar la mi dgos par gsungs pa bzhin/ nged rang gi thog ma mus chen bsod nams dpal bzang gis mnan pa myong can mdzad pas kho bo nas brgyud pa'i slob brgyud lnga la 'di mnon pa dgos/ tshes brgyad rgyal phur 'dzom pa'am/ yang na rgyal phur 'dzoms pa sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe'i rgyun rkang lta bu gang byed kyang gnas dben zhing gtsang bar chag chag dang byi dor byas la/

gnam sa bar gsum gyi rgyan dang / khyad par rin po che'i phung po/ do shal/ gos dar ras snam stag gzig sogs kyi lpags rigs/ go cha shing tog gi rigs/ 'bru sna ja dmar/ sha thud bu ram la sogs pa mkho dgu'i yo byad rnams ci 'byor bsham la stegs mthon por gzhi dmar po bkab pa la me tog dmar po dang rin po che sna tshogs bkram/ mdun bskyed kyi dmigs rten 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sku bris 'bur gang rigs sam/ med na maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gis byugs pa'i khar dri bzang 'o ma gnyis dang nas 'bras gang rung lhan cig du sbyar ba'i tshom bu che ba gcig mañdzi'i khar bshams/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs yod na'ang bzhugs su gsol/ dmigs rten gyi gtso bo maṇ+ḍal dang rigs lngar zla gam sgo can gyi dbus su pad+ma'i steng du mañdzi'i khar rin po che'i sgrom bu'am/ rin po che'i snod nas dang / rin po che'i gang ba la bris sku sor bcu gnyis kyi dpags tshad can cho ga ltar rab gnas byas pa thang sku'am tsakli gang bde brtan par bcug de'i sgo drung gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad la gter bum dang rin chen sna bdun bris pa'am/ yang na de mtshon byed tshom bu bkod/ pad+ma'i lte bar mañdzi'i khar gser dngul la sogs pa snod gas chag med par man ngag nas 'byung ba'i la du dang / la phug la sogs pa zas sna tshogs bzhag rten gtor nor bu'i dbyibs can la cho ga bzhin du bris sku 'jug pa gsung na'ang / phyag len la maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bris sku'i zhal gyi g.yon zur ngos su brten gtor/ g.yas ngos su 'das gtor/ mdun du rgyun gtor bshams pa mdzad/ gang ltar yang gtor ma rnams kyi thad/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ la du/ la phug spos sna tshogs btab pa'i ril bu mar du btsos pas brgyan/ mchod 'go g.yas nas brtsam pa'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod tshar gnyis dang / rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril/

ḍā ma ru/ mdun bskyed la sku khrus gsol ba'i bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings bum sman so lnga bcas dang dung chos rdor gzungs me long sku phyis khrus mthong gos gzung / rol sil rnga dung 'og du dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'dzoms par byas la dpon slob mang du yod na rgyan gos bzang po dang / khyad par tsan+dan nam/ byi ru dmar po sogs kyi phreng ba thogs la gral la 'khod/ 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub yig chen mo dang / yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge gnyis char las sngon 'gro gtor ma bshad pas/ zlum gtor zhig chu chang gis sbyangs/ dpon slob rnams kyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan la ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor zhing / phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa mā ya satwaṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta/ pre ta pi shā tsi/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki nud ya/ i daṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai waṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi ga tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+ya/ sur khaṃ/ bi shūd+dha/ sa ha yak+ṣa bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing srin lag gis nang mchod kyang 'bul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang /

/'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus dang ni thams cad kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas zhing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' bstod yid ltar mgyogs pa yis/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdugs pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /dril bu bcad gtub bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun spyod cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yis/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrung / /dngos grub kun gyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya spyod ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed dang / lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po gnyis sgrub cing mchod par 'tshal na/

srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / deng nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung zhing / dngos grub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig oṃ sum+bha ni/ sogs brjod/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ de nas gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyis nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rol chen dang / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ni ta/ pra ra ni ta/ saṃ pra ra ni ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ta/ pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pa ra mi tā na da swa bhā we badz+ra dharma hrīḥd ya na/ saṇa to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ tshar gsum gyis dang pos mchod yul spyan drangs/ gnyis pas mchod yul de rnams kyi gnas khang byin brlabs/

gsum pas mchod rdzas la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /tshogs bdag gi gzhung rnams las 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bdag bskyed kyi sngon du skyabs sems las ma bshad kyang / rgyas pa ltar na skyabs sems rdo rje rnams la rgyud spyi ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med pas/ de'i tshul ni/ skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar 'byung po 'dul byed skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ rang dgra 'dre byur gsum pha ma rigs drug gi sems can rnams nas/ 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyi kun nas blangs te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bsams pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnamsྎ 'phags pa'i dge 'dunྎ nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas skyabs yul gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ skyabs bya rnams la phog pas sgrib gnyis dag nas sangs rgyas te so so'i zhing du gshegs/ skyabs yul 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis don dam gyi mchog gsum kyang gsal btab/ sems bskyed ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ ngag tu/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis smon 'jug don dam sems bskyed kyang gsal btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang rdo rje'i lam brgyud yum gyi pad mar babs yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pā lā ya/ badz+ra he ru ka tā+e no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ya/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka

ma me muñtsa/ badz+ra he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa mā ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bu/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ rang skad cig gis 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ re re 'gor sbyar ba'i zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shu n+yā ta sogs nas haṃ zhes brjod pas/ gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po rdo rje ba dan rtse gsum dang ldan pa/

g.yon dang pos thod khrag lcang lo dang ldan pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa ha ha'i gad rgyang gis sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'ang 'jig pa mdzad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnam pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ bha bhi shañtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par mos la tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+tar/ rol chen med thal mo sbyar/ 'bar ba'i sku can nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs zhabs kyis sa 'og g.yo/ /rab tu khros pa'i khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug /dpal chen 'byung po'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhad pa'i nga ros sum cu rtsa gsum 'jig /kun tu thogs med gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/ /snying rje'i dbang gis zhi zhing 'gro la brtse/ /dngos grub stsol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes pas bstod/ nang mchod/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ go las ba lang gi sha shar du ku las khyi'i sha byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub du ha las rta'i sha lhor na las mi'i sha de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa las dbus su bī las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las me long / byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtogs pa'i/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dbus su byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po rtse mo 'og tu bstan pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros 'og tu song bas rlung g.yos/ me 'bar rdzas rnams zhu zhing bkol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du bskyed pas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam pa byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnams kyang 'od du zhu/ bdud rtsi la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod bdud rtsi mtheb srin gyis blangs la/

oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod cing myangs/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim/ oṃ sum+bha sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sogs nas/ bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bar 'phreng 'khor ci nus bzlas la/ bzlas pa bsdu na 'phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ zhes brjod pa ni bdag bskyed/ de nas mdun bskyed dad 'bul gyi sku'am tshom bu la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul byas la/ oṃ sum+bha ni bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai we d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gis byin brlabs te/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so so thogs pa mang po sprul nas/ lha thams cad la nang mchod 'bul bar bsam la gdangs mdzad/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/

/oṃ bhu ta ḍa ma ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ sogs mchod pa so so'i ming bcug ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pad+yaṃ sogs sngags bcug nas/ shap+ta'i mthar/ ghan+ḍe ra ni rol chen/ gos zung la rdo rje'i rtses bdud rtsi gtor/ oṃ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /mtshan sngags dang / oṃ badz+ra wasatra ya āḥhūm̐/ nang bdud rtsi mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod la 'bru gsum brjod cing / g.yon du lan gsum bskor bas dbus nas blangs te gtor bas rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pas mchod par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ phyogs bcu dus gsus gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas thog mar rang la bde mchog sogs smin byed kyi dbang bskur stsal zhing / 'di'i chos bskor zhus pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod/ de nas/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ hang du dkar po/ bla ma mal lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rin chen skyobs pa dpal/ rong pa shes rab seṅge/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ 'khon byang chub seṅge/

chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ sa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen rdo rje 'chang dngos ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa 'jam mgon khang gsar ba chen po ngag dbang blo gros snying po dpal bzang po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung pa/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug sngags 'chang gzhon nu stobs ldan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs 'byung / sa chen bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ grub dbang rin chen rgyal mtshan/ lnga rig kun dga' bkra shis/ yab rje kun dga' rin chen/ grub brnyes rdo rje rin chen/

drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mkha' spyod ḍā ki bye ba'i gtso mo rje btsun bskal bzang chos kyi nyi ma rnams kyis zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa dang / gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ suṃm+bha ni nas/ bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ āḥ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ de nas mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug tu bdud rtsi'i thig le bya ste/ 'bru gsum brjod pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ dharma pā la tsa turmu kha badz+ra ka la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ni/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ḍa/ ru lu rak+ṣa si/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥg hūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ wa ra ka tā ya swāhā/ oṃ wa ka te ka daṃṣ+ṭa bin dha hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku'i 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za smyo byed/ brjed byed ma mo zhing skyong / pho nya 'brog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lhar bsam la/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing / zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce la bzhag la 'bru gsum brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas/ hūm̐/ zag med bde ba mchog brnyes he ru ka /bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon por gus btud nas/ /gang gi rnam sprul ma rungs 'byung po'i dgra/ /dpal chen 'byung po 'dul byed bstod par bgyi/ /zung 'jug ye shes ngo bo hūm̐ yig las/ /'od 'phros sra brtan rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /rwa ba drwa gur bla re me 'od bcas/ /bsrung 'khor mchog tu bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dbus chags bral 'dab brgya'i snying po can/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal nyin byed rgyas pa'i dbus/ /'bar ba'i sku can dbang sngon lhun po ni/ /bdag med mi ro'i steng bzhugs la phyag 'tshal/ /ro gcig zhal dang dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan/ /yon tan rab rdzogs sma ra smin ma dang / /dbu skra khams pa dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /gtum rngam 'bar ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med phyag bzhis stong nyid rdo rje dang / /bde chen thod khrag rtsa phyag gnyis kyis 'dzin/

/'og mas phyag gnyis thabs shes mda' gzhu 'geng / /brkyang bskum zhabs kyis mtha' gnyis gnon la 'dud/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thod skam dbu rgyan dang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mgo rlon do shal can/ /'byor ba spel zhing gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rin chen sbrul rgyan stag sham can la 'dud/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /bzhad pa'i nga ros sum cu rtsa gsum 'jig /snying rje'i dbang gi zhi zhing 'gro la brtse/ /dngos grub stsol mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyis/ /ma rungs 'byung po log 'dren mtha' dag 'dul/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i dpal ster ba/ /mtshungs med lha mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar dpal chen 'byung po 'dul byed la/ /bstod pa'i dge des ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal nas/ /bde chen ye shes mchog thob nyid gyur cig /ces pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos bris/ 'das gtor nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bhu ta ḍa ma ra sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar/ a kā rā+o btags pas dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa bstod pa rnams bya/ de nas tshogs bdag gi brten gtor la dmigs nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod chen por byin gyis brlabs/ bris sku bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid khro bo chen por gsal ba'i mdun du baiḍūr+ya'i brag ri'i khrod du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nor bdag byi ba sngon po rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i steng du gaḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba rab tu gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog nag po spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan zhing dar dmar po'i cod paṇa 'phul ba/

phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na dgra satwa mda' chen lcags kyu rdo rje ral gri 'phang mdung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na gtun shing gzhu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa phub dang lhan cig mdung la ba dan btags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi bzhi pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing / lhag ma rnams 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis bzung ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol zhing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su gaḥyig dmar po/ de nas/ rang nyid khro bo chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te mdun gyi tshogs kyi bdag po la thim par mos la/ dril bu bsil zhing / oṃ gaḥgaḥ sid+dha sid+dha sarba ar+tha me pra sā dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa mang du brjod pas bkug pa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ mdun du bsgom pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par mos te/ de la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul nas/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pas dam la bzhag slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs pa sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par mos la tshogs bdag gi mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ spro na/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /lha chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar la'ang 'don pa bsgyur ba'i mthar rol chen bya/

mtshan sngags kyi 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i nang mchod bstod pa/ 'jig rten mgon mdzad snang ba mdzad/ /dal mdzad de bzhin phan pa mdzad/ /mnyam pa med cing dpe med pa/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags dbang phyug rig sngags rgyal/ /longs spyod 'byung gnas gter gyi mchog /'bras bu yin par ston pa po/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po bdud las rgyal/ /stobs chen nyon mongs g.yul ngo 'joms/ /bgegs 'joms 'jig rten 'joms mdzad pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /rin chen chen po rin chen sku/ /rin chen chen po rin chen 'byung / /rin chen bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /tshogs kyi bdag po rdzu 'phrul che/ /lha dmag bkra ba'i dbugs 'byin zhing / /lha min nag po'i g.yul bzlog pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /sku ni yon tan rin chen te/ /gsung ni yon tan ngo bo nyid/ /thugs ni yon tan bdag nyid can/ /glang chen snar ldan khyed la 'dud/ /'di grub chen nag po spyod pas mdzad/ gzhan yang / rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /tshogs rje tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag /bgegs kyi gtso la mchod cing bstod/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa dang / /la du la sogs mthun rdzas kyis/ /bgegs rgyal tshogs bdag 'khor bcas mchod/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol/ /'di gong mas mdzad pas yar lung pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis gsung / rgyun gtor mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ ga na pa ti la/ nam mkha' mdzod du sngags btags pas dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod nang mchod/ rgyal ba'i phrin las las sgrub pa'i/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs kun bcom nas/ /sgrub la dngos sgrub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /'dod dgu char 'bebs khyed la bstod/ /gang zhig sgrub par byed pa la/ /legs par sgrub pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/

/mthong tsam du'ang mi 'gyur ba'i/ /tshogs kyi bdag po khyed la bstod/ /byi ru ltar dmar brjid pa'i sku/ /thogs med las grub rig sngags gsung / /bde chen gnyis med ye shes thugs/ /bde ba'i mchog gis sprul mdzad bstod/ /mchod yon me tog spos mar me/ /dri dang bza' bca' btung ba bgo /rgyan dang rol mo sna tshogs kyis/ /mdzes pa'i mchod gtor rgya mtshos mchod/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes nas kyang / /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /'di chos rba bla mas mdzad/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad srungs/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / mdor na bsam pa'i don 'di dag thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin du 'grub cing / khyad par brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces 'dod don zhus/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa mdun gyi tshogs bdag gi thugs ka'i gaḥyig sngags kyis bskor ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas skye 'gro dbang du bsdus shing zas nor gyi char phab nas dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsam zhing / sum bha/ brgya phrag la sogs pas 'go drangs pa'i/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes 'bum phrag gcig gam 'bru 'bum bzla/ oṃ wa ra ka na ye swāhā/ oṃ wa ga te ka daṃṣ+ḍa bin dha hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/

oṃ bh+rūm̐ ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ sprin gzungs kyang bzla ste/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ na mo/ te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye/ oṃ gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥ oṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa dhī pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa shwa rā ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti pu dzi ta swāhā/ oṃ ḍa ḍa ka ḍa ma da ma da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ha na ha na/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ dhā wa dhā wa/ bhañdza bhañdza/ stam+bha stam+bha/ mo ha mo ha/ de hi de hi/ da da pā ya/ da da pā ya/ dha na sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha na mo sdu be ma hā ru tra pa tsā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥbhu ta bhan dhu k+ṣū ba ta ra tu tu ma hā swāhā/ sa mā gats+tshan+ta te/ na maḥ.a mṛ ta/ bin dhu k+ṣu ta/ tsit+ta ma hā sa ma/ gats+tsha ti ma hā/ bha ga ma hā/ bā la phra kra ma/ ma ṇa hā te/ pra bha da dā ma swāhā/ oṃ na mo stu ti ma hā ga ṇe pa ta ye swāhā/ a gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥ gaḥṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa dhi pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇe shwa ra ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti pu dzi ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ su ru mu ru swāhā/ oṃ na mo na ma swāhā/ oṃ na mo stu te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ mā ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya sarba satwa nan tsa sarba bighān bi na ya ka ni shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ sogs gong bzhin 'dod gsol bya/ bum pa/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du baṃ paṃ las pad+ma dang / nas/ dbu brgyan bar mdun bskyed bzhin gyis 'byung 'dul bskyed/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams byas la/

gzungs thag bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes dang / sum+bha ni sogs 'byung 'dul gyi sngags ci nus dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi sogs khrus rnams ci nus bzla/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sh+lau ka gcig pad bskor dang bcas dung chos kyi chu phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gyi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ ces brjod/ me long sku phyis bum pa khrus chu sogs thogs nas/ bris sku me long gi ngos su shar ba la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus gsol/ de dag sku la sogs kyis sku phyis/ rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang mchod rdzas rnams 'dod yon lngar dmigs la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen sbyin/ /la du la phug 'bras bu yid 'ong zas/ /phyogs bcu'i chu skyes longs spyod rgyan/ /ris med phyed pa'i mchod sprin rgyas par 'bul/ /maṇ+ḍal dam pa rab tu mdzes pa dang / /bshos gtsang mar me yon chab sna tshogs dang / /'bras chang dgun chang la phug btung ba'i mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram la sogs mngar ba'i ro/ /lhan cig skyes dang rab du sbyar ba yis/ /sna tshogs mchod pa dam pa 'di dag bzhes/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i rnam 'phrul las/ /byung ba'i bla med mchod pa 'di dag 'bul/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg sogs kun ldan pa'i/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /bdag nyid dad pas bshams shing sprul pa yi/

/mchod pa'i tshogs kyis lha chen mnyes gyur cig /de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /tshogs kyi bdag po'i zhabs pad la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong mchod rdzas ji snyed rnams/ /bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas rnams dang / /tshogs kyi bdag po'i spyan lam du/ /dad pa'i sems kyis dbul bar bgyi/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /lus dang sems dang yid gsum gyis/ /nyes pa'i spyod pa gang bgyis pa/ /rab tu 'gyod pas bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rgyal sras dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal skye bo dang / /tshogs kyi bdag po'i dge ba la/ /kun nas rjes su yi rang ngo / /gang rnams byang chub mchog rtogs pa/ /bdag gis gsol bas rgyal ba kun/ /'gro ba rnams kyi don byed du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bya ba thams cad byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das bzhed kun/ /bdag gi gsol btab ji srid du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /de bzhin 'phags pa tshogs bdag la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang de yi sras/ /'gro la phan par bzhed pa rnams/ /ji ltar smon pa de bzhin du/ /bdag gi yid kyis smon par bgyi/ /bsod nams tshad med bsags pa rnams/ /ji ltar rgyal bas bsngags pa bzhin/ /rigs drug sems can don ched du/ /bdag gis byang chub chen por bsngo/ /lan gsum/ 'di sa paṇa gyis mdzad/ sa gsum gdug pa kun 'dul rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i dbang po de la gus btud nas/ /dbang phyug phun tshogs tshogs kyi bdag po la/ /dad pa'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi/ /rab brjid baiḍūr sngon po'i lhun po'i dbus/ /sna tshogs rin chen las grub mtsho skyes dang / /rta bdun can dang nor bdag byi ba yis/ /steng na bzhugs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'gro la rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /gti mug rab spang gnyis 'thung gdong pa can/ /rten 'brel rin chen bcu gnyis phyag gis mdzes/ /rol pa'i zhabs gnyis ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra satwa mda' chen lcags kyu rdo rje dang / /ral gri 'phang mdung 'bar ba'i mtshon cha yis/ /nyid sku'i g.yas pa'i phyag gis pad+ma bsnams/ /mdzes par byas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs 'jom gtum shing gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /khrag dang sha yis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /rnam par rgyal ba'i phub dang ba dan rnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung bsam 'phel rin po che/ /yid bzhin nor bus spyi bor brgyan pa la/ /yid 'ong dar dmar cod paṇa mang g.yos pas/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdog legs dri zhim rig na bde ba yis/ /srab 'jam dar gyis sku stod legs g.yogs shing / /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyi lhab lhub kyis/ /sku smad mdzes par byas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu tig byi ru margad dbang sngon dang / /rdo yi snying po spug dang man shel sogs/ /'jig rten 'di na dkon pa'i rin chen kyis/ /phreng bas do shal byas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khros shing rab dmar spyan gsum sdang mig g.yos/ /rno dkar mche ba rab gtsigs mi bzad zhal/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na/ /dpa' bo sgeg par bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sku gsal bar dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas byed cing / /mi mthun gnod pa mtha' dag 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gsung gsang sngags zab mo bzlas tsam gyis/ /stobs ldan mi dang mi ma yin la sogs/ /ma lus skad cig tsam gyis 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /mthu stobs thogs med ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid thugs yon tan rgya mtsho dran tsam gyis/ /skye dgu'i yid kyi gdung ba kun bsal nas/ /'chi med bsam gtan bde ba thob byed pa'i/

/spros kun mkha' ltar dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen me tog 'bras bu sman dang spos/ /la du la phug glang sha rgun 'brum chang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum 'khur ba 'bras chen sogs/ /lha dang mi yi longs spyod 'di 'bul gyis/ /mgon khyod 'gro la rab tu brtse ba'i phyir/ /'dri dang bcas 'di bzhes shing gsol nas kyang / /lha khyod bdag gis gus par bsten pa yis/ /re ba'i 'bras bu thams cad mchis par mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / 'gro kun dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal po blon po grong khyer de la sogs/ /'gro mang bdag gis dbang du bsdus byas nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsis tshim par byas pa'i mthus/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde bar mdzad du gsol/ /longs spyod ched du 'thab cing rtsod pa dang / /mdza' dang bral dang sdom gsum nyams pa sogs/ /mi dge 'phel ba'i longs spyod rgyang bsring nas/ /dge ba'i longs spyod 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /dkon mchog dkor sogs log pa'i 'tsho ba dang / /'byor pa rgyas pa'i dam chos bral ba sogs/ /dman pa'i longs spyod mtha' dag rab spangs nas/ /yang dag 'tsho bas 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol/ /bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i/ /chos mthun 'tsho ba rmad du byung ba rnams/ /'bad med char bzhin 'babs par mdzad du gsol/ /mi bsrun skye bo skal ngan gdug pa can/ /bstan dang sems can kun la 'tshe byed rnams/ /khyod kyi mthu las bdag gis dbang gyur nas/ /bstan la dad cing gus par mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba'i mthus/ /nyid thugs zag med nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ /rnam dag longs spyod rgya chen rab blangs nas/ /'gro mang dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi byed shog /'di ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad/

ces pas mchod bstod byas la/ de nas brten gtor 'bul zhing bskang ba bya ba ni/ rten gtor nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ spyan gzigs sogs yo byad rnams la dmigs nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ rnga rol dung sogs kyi sgra dang a ka ru sogs dri zhim po'i spos kyi dud pa sbyar la/ spyan drangs pa ni/ gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ gaḥ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /bla ma rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad bcas/ /tshogs kyi bdag por gus btud nas/ /bgegs 'dul 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /spyan sngar snying po phul nas ni/ /log 'dren thams cad 'dul ba dang / /'gro kun ma lus dbang bsdus nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sgrub la phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /mi nyams rtag tu rgyas mdzad pa/ /dam bcas gang de 'dir dgongs la/ /tshangs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /byin rlabs mchod gnas dam pa 'dir/ /gegs sel phun tshogs rgyas pa'i phyir/ /lha chen 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /brtse bas gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /sgrub po 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba dang / /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsid+dhi sid+dhi/ sarba ar+tha me pra sā dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes nyer gcig sogs ci nus bzlas la sum cu rtsa gsum nas spyan drangs/ oṃ dbyibs legs kha dog sna tshogs shing / /'dab ma stong gis rab mdzes pa'i/ /pad nyi'i gdan la rab bzhugs nas/ /bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ aḥkā ro mu khaṃ sogs btags pa lan ji ltar rigs pas gtor ma phul/ mtshan sngags gcig sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod nang mchod 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos bskang rdzas kyi mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ yid 'ong gtsang zhing dag pa yi/ /mchod yon gtsang gtor mchog 'di dang / /yid 'phrog me tog dri zhim spos/ /sgron me sna tshogs dri yi mchog /lha rdzas las sbyar zhal zas dang / /rab mdzes gar dang snyan pa'i glu/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /bgegs 'dul lha chen bcas la 'bul/ /gzhan yang rin chen rin thang med/ /yid la 'dod dgu sna tshogs dang / /rkang 'gros sna tshogs yid 'ong rgyan/ /sna tshogs gos dang gser dngul 'bru/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis legs sprul pa/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod rdzas ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs te dbul/ /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /tshe dang bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang 'byor pa phun tshogs shog /ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /spyan 'dren dang mchod phreng 'di 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad/ oṃ 'bras chan la phug 'khur ba dang / /sbrang rtsi dkar gsum rgum 'brum sogs/ /yid 'ong 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / /zhim pa'i bza' ba btung bar bcas/ /bca' ba sna tshogs gur gum sogs/ /yid 'ong dri yis legs bgos shing / /me tog dar dpyangs la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa'i/ /zhal zas gtsang zhing yid 'ong 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /lha mi'i bdud rtsi phun tshogs par/ /byin brlabs nam mkha'i mtha' gtug par/ /rgyun mi chad par blos sprul nas/ /bgegs rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag cag bsam pa 'grub slad du/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /gzhan yang mchod pa rgya chen po/ /rin chen rgyan spras gzhal med khang / /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis byed pa'i rdzas brgyad dang / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing / /ma rmos lo tog gser dngul 'bru/ /rta dang glang po shing rta'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs gos dang rin chen rgyan/

/gdug dang rgyal mtshan rol gar dbyangs/ /go mtshon sna tshogs bran g.yog bcas/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul ba/ /rab tu dges pas bzhes par mdzod/ /me tog 'bras bu shing las byung / /bcos dang sbyar ba las skyes pa'i/ /myos byed sna tshogs yid 'ong ba/ /gus pas khyed la 'bul bar bgyi/ /spu sdug dbyibs legs yan lag mdzes/ /shugs can mgyogs 'gro rngog ma brjid/ /rta mchog rin chen rgyan spras pa/ /bgegs 'dul khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /de ltar rgya chen mchod pa'i tshogs/ /lha chen 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /'gro ba kun gyi don slad du/ /dgos pa chen pos rab bzhes nas/ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyang / /rtag tu mi nyams rgyas pa dang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang gyur nas/ /yid la bsam pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams dang / /tshe dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /gang yang mchod yon 'khor bcas la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /lha chen mthu yis zil mnan nas/ /gus pas las rnams grub par mdzod/ /ci ste 'grub par ma gyur na/ /ci nas gnod cing 'tshe ba rnams/ /mngon spyod tshul gyis tshar bcad nas/ /kun du nyer 'tshe med par mdzod/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu thams cad du/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin kun nas zhabs brtan cing / /'chi med dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /nad med lo thog phun tshogs shing / /'gro kun lhag bsam dag pa dang / /gzhung lugs bzang po'i tshul gnas pas/ /'jig rten kun tu dge bar mdzod/ /khyed sgrub khyed mchod gsol 'debs la/ /tshe dang bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /mthu dang 'byor pa phun tshogs pas/ /bskal pa'i bar du legs gnas mdzod/ /'di chos rje bla ma'i bstod pa rgyas pa'i gsham nas bsdus/ hūm̐ gaḥdapal ldan pad+ma ra ga'i mdog mtshungs nyin mor byed ltar ches cher gsal ba'i sku/

/glang chen zhal gcig mche gcig bcu gnyis phyag ldan zhabs gnyis gar stabs tshul/ /dgra satwa gtun shing mda' gzhu kha ṭ+wāṃ lcags kyu khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang / /rdo rje ral gri sha chen thod pa phub dang ba dan rtse gsum 'phang mdung 'dzin/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' bklubs shing rnam mang rin chen rgyan gyis rab du spras/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs gtsug tu bcings shing nor bu'i tog can cod paṇa dmar pos mdzes/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis yid 'phrog byed cing gzhan du drag shul sgra yis skrag par mdzad/ /byams dang snying rje'i nye bar zhi zhing lha min dpung 'joms mi bzad rngam pa can/ /rab tu gzugs mdzes 'dzum pa'i bzhin ldan glu dang gar byed lha dang lha mos mchod/ /rdzu 'phrul du mas rnam 'phrul mthu stobs mtha' yas bgegs rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing sogs 'dod dgu'i longs spyod rnam pa lnga mdzad pa/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal tshogs rje tshogs bdag tshogs kyi dbang phyug khyod la 'dud cing bstod/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri bcas legs par bshams pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /dang ba'i yid kyis legs 'bul bdag la brtser dgongs ci bde bar ni bzhes mdzod la/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi zhing skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bdag gi dbang du gyur pa dang / /tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod kun nas rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'di 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad/ paṃ pad raṃ nyi'i gdan steng du/ /hūm̐ byung rdo rje las 'khrungs shing / /phyag g.yas rdo rje ba dan bcas/ /g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams la bstod/ /'og ma mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs/ /mgo 'phreng rgyan drug sbrul rgyan bcas/ /brkyang bskums gar gyis rol pa yis/ /bgegs 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi bka' nyan mthu stobs can/ /rin chen sna tshogs brag ri'i steng / /pad nyi bye ba'i gdan la bzhugs/

/gaḥyig las byung khyod la bstod/ /bgegs kyi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag po ni/ /byi ru'i mdog can glang chen zhal/ /zhal gcig 'dzum khro mche gtsigs bstod/ /dgra 'joms rdo rje dgra satwa dang / /'gro kun dbang byed rdo rje mda'/ /skye dgu 'gugs don lcags kyu dang / /bgegs 'dul rdo rje bsnams la bstod/ /gza' bsrung 'bar ba'i ral gri rno/ /bsam zhing sgrub byed 'phang mdung rnams/ /g.yas bsnams g.yon pa'i dang po yis/ /bgegs bsod gtun shing 'dzin la bstod/ /'gro kun dbang bsdud rdo rje gzhu/ /'byung po dga' byed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'gro ba 'gugs byed thod khrag dang / /nor sgrub shas gang thod 'dzin bstod/ /gnod pa kun skyob phub dang ni/ /ba dan bcas pa g.yon pa yis/ /'dzin zhing 'bar ba'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /rab sgeg ral pas brjid la bstod/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis sku la brgyan/ /sna tshogs rin chen dar gyis spras/ /'od zer dmar po cher 'khrugs shing / /me dpung dbus gnas khyod la bstod/ /'di chos rje bla mas mdzad/ ces pas bstod la/ 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ hūm̐ gaḥ sngon tshe thub dbang he ru ka dpal gyi/ /spyan sngar dam bcas zhal bzhes rjes dran pas/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshangs pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /da lta nyid du ma thogs gnas 'dir byon/ /bdag gi dngos bshams yid sprul mchod gtor rnams/ /lha chen khyod kyis dges shing brtse bas bzhes/ /ji ltar bsam bzhin gsol ba btab pa'i don/ /gegs med da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ /yun ring tshe dang phun tshogs 'byor pa rgyas/ /yangs pa'i sa chen 'bru bcud smin pa'i ljongs/ /dregs ldan lha mi btsan phyug skye bo rnams/ /myur bar bdag gis dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po'i mthu stobs kyis/

/ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /'di tshar chen rin po ches bstod bshams nas 'byung / de ltar bla ma rang sems lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyer med dbang sdud lha chen khyod bstod pas/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'chi bdag las rgyal nas/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin nyid du mdzod/ /nam yang 'byung bzhi'i nad kyis mi brdzi zhing / /gangs can ljongs 'di'i rgyal po'i blon po dang / /grong khyer la sogs gzugs dang gzugs med kyi/ /stobs ldan dregs byed thams cad dbang bsdus mdzod/ /de la brten nas spyi dang bye brag gis/ /bstan pa nus ldan 'phel ba'i mthu ldan zhing / /sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs brgyud dri med kun/ /ji srid bskal pa'i bar du mi chad mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar mdzod/ /'di 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis dmar po skor gsum bstod gshams nas 'byung / hūm̐ gaḥ gsang bdag bka' bstod lha chen tshogs kyi bdag /khyod ni mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul kun mnga' bas/ /sngon tshe 'gro mgon zangs tshas bka' bsgos ltar/ /sa ston ri pa sa skya'i gdung brgyud du/ /spyan drangs bla chen 'phags pa zhes su 'khrungs/ /rgya bod khams gsum snod bcud dbang du bsdus/ /'dzam gling shākya'i ring lugs sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dri med nyi 'od lta bur mdzad/ /de sogs dpal ldan sa skya'i 'phrin las kun/ /lha chen khyod kyis rgyun du sgrub mod kyi/ /da dung khyed la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing yun tu brtan pa'i phyir/ /'chi med 'khon rigs rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud dri med lo zla ma 'gyangs pa/ /myur tu 'byon zhing byon pa de dag kyang / /sangs rgyas byang sems rnam sprul sha stag la/

/mi dang mi min phas rgol gang gis kyang / /mtho 'tshams bar chad kun gyis mi tshugs shing / /bdud dang bdud kyi rjes 'brang ji snyed kun/ /skad cig tsam gyis rdul du rlog pa la/ /phyag na rdo rje lta bu'i mthu stobs mdzod/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor legs tshogs kun/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu rgyas gyur nas/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs gang lags pa/ /de kun bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'khor los bsgyur rgyal sogs/ /stobs ldan rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang / /yid bzhin nor bu gter bum dpag bsam shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang nyi zla'i 'od la sogs/ /srid na che dgu ji snyed mchis pa dang / /khyad par gangs ri'i ljongs kyi skye 'gro kun/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i dbang du myur bsdus nas/ /phan bde dpal 'byor ma lus mthar phyin mdzod/ /ces tshogs kyi bdag po la phrin las 'chol ba 'di dpal sa skya pa kun blos bris/ oṃ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /oṃ dpal chen phyag na rdo rje'i gzi brjid dang / /lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po'i mthu rtsal dang / /dbang chen nor lha'i tshogs kyi phrin las kyis/ /sa chen 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /tshogs yod na skabs 'dir ma rgyud spyi ltar bya/ de nas mdun bskyed mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ bhu ta bi na ya ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta'i bar sbyar la mthar rol chen/

mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ dpal chen ston ka'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing / /dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ gis 'brug stong chem/ /'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa/ /phyag na rdo rje snams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ phyogs bcu na sogs kyis brtan bzhugs/ 'byung 'dul gyi tshom bu de spung dgos pa yin na/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyis gshegs gsol/ nor lha gtso bsdus ma shes tshogs bdag la gshegs gsol byed mi nyan/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /sogs kyis bsngo smon ci shes dang / phyogs kun du me tog gi char 'bebs la/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis dang / khyad par dmar po skor gsum sogs nor lha gtso bsdus kyi bkra shis 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ de rang gis bsgrigs pa'i rig byed lha mor mchod gtor 'bul tshul gyi gsham nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ bris sku mchod gtor dang bcas pa mgon khang ngam bang mdzod la sogs pa'i gnas dben zhing mtho bar sbas la mis mi mthong bar bya zhing / dpon slob kun dang ston la rol lo/ /zhes dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i gtor bsngo ba dang bcas pa rgyas par bya tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa lugs kyi bla ma gong ma mang po'i gsung rab phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas khrigs chags su bkod pa yin pas 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs med snyam zhig 'on kyang bdag blo rmongs pas mdo rgyud rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan rnams dang /

bla ma gong ma'i phyag len dang 'gal ba'i rigs shar tshe mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdig dang lhan cig bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar bshags shing / de'i dge bas bstan 'gro yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud chad med myur du byon nas chos srid dpal 'byor phun tshogs rgyas te 'gro kun legs pa'i lam la spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig yid 'phrog pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo bzhin/ /yid can snying brtse 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu yis/ /yid bzhin dngos grub gter mdzad lhag pa'i lha/ /yid 'ong rig byed lha mo'i bkra shis shog /dpal 'bar gang sku'i rnam pa dran tsam gyis/ /dpal mchog srid gsum 'byung po dbang bsdus nas/ /dpal 'byor yid kyi shing rta 'gengs pa'i lha/ /dpal ldan 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i bkra shis shog /khams gsum chos dang srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ /dbang byed khams gsum 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gtso/ /rab 'byams bgegs kyi rgyal po tshogs dbang phyug /lha tshogs 'dod dgu'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /phun tshogs rigs lnga rdo rje lcags kyu yis/ /sna tshogs skye dgu'i glang po nyer drangs te/ /dge tshogs 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod 'gengs pa'i lha/ /chu dbang snying rje'i gter kyi bkra shis shog /rab brjid gser gyi lhun po lta bu'i sku/ /rab 'byams chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /rab mang skye dgu'i snying la bde ster ma/ /rab mchog ngal gso rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog/ //ces pa 'di yang rgyal po'i pho brang dpal 'byor rab rgyas legs su byed pa'i ched du/ dpal sa skya'i snyan brgyud 'dzin pa ban+dhe mkhyen brtses bgyis pa'o// //bkra shis/ dge'o// //bris rkos gnas gsar sri gcod rdo rjes zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'byung po 'dul byed dang tshogs kyi bdag po mchod cing bskang ba'i cho ga PAGE
